exposure: Diastolic notch in uterine artery Doppler
Abnormal pulsatility index (PI) in uterine artery Doppler
cohort: Sixty-eight high-risk pregnant women without pre-existing hypertension, heart failure, recurrent pregnancy loss, autoimmune disorders, or diabetes.
finding: Bilateral diastolic notch with abnormal PI in uterine artery Doppler during the second trimester was associated with poor perinatal outcomes, but this association was not observed with NT-proBNP levels.
mod_finding: Rate of cesarean section was significantly different between the groups.
gest_age: 21-24 weeks at the time of Doppler ultrasound
